# Command reference

Every `baguette` command and flag, generated from the binary. For how to use a feature, start at the [docs index](https://github.com/tddworks/baguette/blob/main/docs/README.md).

**Common flag** (on every simulator command, not repeated below):
`--device-set <path>`: a custom device set (defaults to Xcode's default set).

**Exit codes:** `0` on success, `1` on any error, `3` when an iPhone Duo `orientation` or `hinge` change is unconfirmed: its guest helper timed out, so the change may have landed and will not land later. Errors print `{"ok":false,"error":"…"}`, so parse stdout, not just the exit code.

**Commands:** [list](#baguette-list) · [boot](#baguette-boot) · [shutdown](#baguette-shutdown) · [lifetime](#baguette-lifetime) · [input](#baguette-input) · [stream](#baguette-stream) · [tap](#baguette-tap) · [double-tap](#baguette-double-tap) · [swipe](#baguette-swipe) · [pinch](#baguette-pinch) · [pan](#baguette-pan) · [press](#baguette-press) · [key](#baguette-key) · [type](#baguette-type) · [paste](#baguette-paste) · [clipboard](#baguette-clipboard) · [chrome](#baguette-chrome) · [screenshot](#baguette-screenshot) · [record](#baguette-record) · [render-3d](#baguette-render-3d) · [describe-ui](#baguette-describe-ui) · [logs](#baguette-logs) · [serve](#baguette-serve) · [orientation](#baguette-orientation) · [hinge](#baguette-hinge) · [shake](#baguette-shake) · [status-bar](#baguette-status-bar) · [interface](#baguette-interface) · [location](#baguette-location) · [motion](#baguette-motion) · [network](#baguette-network) · [install](#baguette-install) · [add-media](#baguette-add-media) · [openurl](#baguette-openurl) · [schemes](#baguette-schemes) · [plugin](#baguette-plugin) · [bakery](#baguette-bakery) · [diag-digitizer-trackpad](#baguette-diag-digitizer-trackpad) · [heal](#baguette-heal)

## baguette list

List simulators in the default or a custom device set

```
baguette list [--json]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  | Emit one running/available JSON envelope (matches /simulators.json) |

## baguette boot

Boot a simulator headlessly

```
baguette boot --udid <udid> [--no-heal]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--no-heal` |  |  | Leave the input surface alone even if Xcode 27's Device Hub has shadowed it (see `baguette heal`). |

## baguette shutdown

Shut down a booted simulator

```
baguette shutdown --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

## baguette lifetime

Show or change whether Simulator.app leaves devices booted

```
baguette lifetime [--detach] [--shutdown]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--detach` |  |  | Leave devices booted when a window closes or Simulator.app quits. |
| `--shutdown` |  |  | Restore Apple's default: closing a window or quitting shuts the device down. |

## baguette input

Read newline-delimited JSON gestures from stdin, ack each on stdout

```
baguette input --udid <udid> [--display <display>] [--require-existing-display]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--display` |  |  | Target display plane: phone \| carplay |
| `--require-existing-display` |  |  | Require the target display to be attached; never enable CarPlay implicitly |

## baguette stream

Stream framebuffer to stdout (mjpeg / avcc). Reads runtime config commands from stdin.

```
baguette stream --udid <udid> [--format <format>] [--fps <fps>] [--quality <quality>] [--bitrate <bitrate>] [--scale <scale>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--format` |  | `mjpeg` | Output format: mjpeg \| avcc |
| `--fps` |  | `60` | Frames per second |
| `--quality` |  | `0.7` | JPEG quality (0.0 – 1.0) |
| `--bitrate` |  | `8000000` | H.264 average bitrate (bps) |
| `--scale` |  | `1` | Integer downscale divisor (1 = native) |

## baguette chrome

Read DeviceKit chrome (bezel) data for a simulator

### baguette chrome layout

Print the chrome layout JSON for the named device

```
baguette chrome layout [--udid <udid>] [--device-name <device-name>] [--panel <panel>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` |  |  | Simulator UDID (resolved via CoreSimulator) |
| `--device-name` |  |  | Device-type name, e.g. "iPhone 17 Pro" |
| `--panel` |  |  | Panel of a foldable: cover \| unfolded (default: the lit one) |

### baguette chrome composite

Write the rasterized composite bezel PNG to stdout

```
baguette chrome composite [--udid <udid>] [--device-name <device-name>] [--panel <panel>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` |  |  | Simulator UDID (resolved via CoreSimulator) |
| `--device-name` |  |  | Device-type name, e.g. "iPhone 17 Pro" |
| `--panel` |  |  | Panel of a foldable: cover \| unfolded (default: the lit one) |

## baguette screenshot

Capture one frame from a simulator's screen

```
baguette screenshot --udid <udid> [--output <output>] [--metadata-output <metadata-output>] [--quality <quality>] [--scale <scale>] [--size <size>] [--fit <fit>] [--background <background>] [--format <format>] [--display <display>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--output` |  |  | Output file (defaults to stdout) |
| `--metadata-output` |  |  | Write this frame's pixel geometry as JSON to a separate file |
| `--quality` |  | `0.85` | JPEG quality (0.0 – 1.0); ignored for PNG |
| `--scale` |  | `1` | Integer downscale divisor (1 = native) |
| `--size` |  | `native` | Output size: WIDTHxHEIGHT, W:H, or one of: native \| appstore-6.9 \| appstore-6.5 \| appstore-ipad-13 \| square \| 16:9 \| 9:16 \| 4:3 \| 4:5 |
| `--fit` |  | `contain` | How the frame fills the size: contain, cover, stretch |
| `--background` |  | `#ffffff` | Letterbox background: transparent or #RRGGBB |
| `--format` |  |  | Image format: png \| jpg (defaults to the --output extension, else jpg) |
| `--display` |  |  | Target display plane: phone \| carplay |

## baguette record

Record a simulator's screen to an H.264 video file

```
baguette record --udid <udid> --output <output> [--size <size>] [--fit <fit>] [--background <background>] [--fps <fps>] [--duration <duration>] [--bitrate <bitrate>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--output` | yes |  | Output video file — .mp4 or .mov |
| `--size` |  | `native` | Output size: native \| appstore-6.9 \| appstore-6.5 \| appstore-ipad-13 \| square \| 16:9 \| 9:16 \| 4:3 \| 4:5, WIDTHxHEIGHT, or W:H |
| `--fit` |  | `contain` | Frame placement: contain \| cover \| stretch |
| `--background` |  | `#ffffff` | Letterbox background as #RRGGBB (video has no alpha) |
| `--fps` |  | `30` | Frames per second (1 – 120) |
| `--duration` |  |  | Stop N seconds after launch (omit to record until Ctrl-C) |
| `--bitrate` |  | `8000000` | H.264 average bitrate (bps) |

## baguette render-3d

Render a simulator screen on an installed 3D device model

```
baguette render-3d [--udid <udid>] [--screen <screen>] [--device <device>] [--screen-orientation <screen-orientation>] [--hinge-degrees <hinge-degrees>] [--variant <variant> …] [--rotation <rotation>] [--size <size>] [--fit <fit>] [--background <background>] [--screen-glass] [--output <output>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` |  |  | Simulator UDID to capture |
| `--screen` |  |  | Existing PNG or JPEG screen image |
| `--device` |  |  | Installed 3D model definition ID |
| `--screen-orientation` |  |  | With --screen: the interface orientation the capture was taken in, so it renders upright. One of: portrait, landscape-left, landscape-right, portrait-upside-down. |
| `--hinge-degrees` |  |  | With --screen and a foldable model: fold angle, 0 through 180 degrees |
| `--variant` |  |  | Model variant as SET=CHOICE (repeatable) |
| `--rotation` |  | `0,0,0` | Device rotation as X,Y,Z degrees |
| `--size` |  |  | Output size: WIDTHxHEIGHT, W:H, or one of: native \| appstore-6.9 \| appstore-6.5 \| appstore-ipad-13 \| square \| 16:9 \| 9:16 \| 4:3 \| 4:5 (defaults to the captured screen size) |
| `--fit` |  | `cover` | Screen placement: cover, contain, or stretch |
| `--background` |  | `transparent` | Canvas background: transparent or #RRGGBB |
| `--screen-glass` |  |  | Composite a reflective cover glass over the screen |
| `--output` |  |  | Output PNG file (defaults to stdout) |

## baguette describe-ui

Dump the simulator's accessibility tree as JSON

```

```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--x` |  |  | Hit-test x coordinate (device points). Pair with --y. |
| `--y` |  |  | Hit-test y coordinate (device points). Pair with --x. |
| `--output` |  |  | Output file (defaults to stdout) |

## baguette logs

Stream the booted simulator's unified log to stdout

```
baguette logs --udid <udid> [--level <level>] [--style <style>] [--predicate <predicate>] [--bundle-id <bundle-id>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--level` |  | `info` | Minimum log level: default \| info \| debug |
| `--style` |  | `default` | Output style: default \| compact \| json \| syslog \| ndjson |
| `--predicate` |  |  | NSPredicate string passed to `log stream --predicate` verbatim |
| `--bundle-id` |  |  | Convenience: filter to a specific process by bundle / image name. ANDs with --predicate when both given. |

## baguette serve

Start the standalone simulator UI server

```
baguette serve [--port <port>] [--host <host>] [--allowed-hosts <allowed-hosts> …] [--plugin-dir <plugin-dir> …] [--no-plugins]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--port` |  | `8421` | Port to listen on |
| `--host` |  | `127.0.0.1` | Host / interface to bind to |
| `--allowed-hosts` |  |  | Additional Host/Origin value to trust (repeatable; "*.example.com" matches subdomains) |
| `--plugin-dir` |  |  | Extra directory of plugins; repeatable. Shadows installed plugins of the same name. |
| `--no-plugins` |  |  | Ignore every installed plugin, including bundled ones. |

## baguette status-bar

Override or clear the booted simulator's status bar

### baguette status-bar override

Set one or more status-bar overrides

```
baguette status-bar override --udid <udid> [--time <time>] [--operator-name <operator-name>] [--data-network <data-network>] [--wifi-mode <wifi-mode>] [--wifi-bars <wifi-bars>] [--cellular-mode <cellular-mode>] [--cellular-bars <cellular-bars>] [--battery-state <battery-state>] [--battery-level <battery-level>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--time` |  |  | Fixed clock value, e.g. "9:41". An ISO date string also sets the date. |
| `--operator-name` |  |  | Cellular carrier name ("" blanks it) |
| `--data-network` |  |  | Data network: hide \| wifi \| 3g \| 4g \| lte \| lte-a \| lte+ \| 5g \| 5g+ \| 5g-uwb \| 5g-uc One of: hide, wifi, 3g, 4g, lte, lte-a, lte+, 5g, 5g+, 5g-uwb, 5g-uc. |
| `--wifi-mode` |  |  | Wi-Fi mode: searching \| failed \| active One of: searching, failed, active. |
| `--wifi-bars` |  |  | Wi-Fi signal bars, 0-3 |
| `--cellular-mode` |  |  | Cellular mode: notSupported \| searching \| failed \| active One of: notSupported, searching, failed, active. |
| `--cellular-bars` |  |  | Cellular signal bars, 0-4 |
| `--battery-state` |  |  | Battery state: charging \| charged \| discharging One of: charging, charged, discharging. |
| `--battery-level` |  |  | Battery percentage, 0-100 |

### baguette status-bar clear

Clear every status-bar override

```
baguette status-bar clear --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

## baguette location

Set, route, walk, or clear the booted simulator's simulated GPS location

### baguette location set

Pin the simulator to a lat,lon position

```
baguette location set --udid <udid> <position>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `<position>` | yes |  | Position as a lat,lon token, e.g. 37.3318,-122.0312 |

### baguette location start

Run a moving route between two or more lat,lon waypoints

```
baguette location start --udid <udid> [--speed <speed>] [--distance <distance>] [--interval <interval>] [<waypoints> …]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--speed` |  |  | Speed in metres/second (default: simctl's 20) |
| `--distance` |  |  | Metres travelled between location updates |
| `--interval` |  |  | Seconds between location updates |
| `<waypoints>` |  |  | Waypoints as lat,lon tokens (two or more) |

### baguette location walk

Walk from a lat,lon position along a compass bearing, driving CLLocation.course

```
baguette location walk --udid <udid> --bearing <bearing> --speed <speed> <position>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--bearing` | yes |  | Compass bearing in degrees clockwise from north (0 = N, 90 = E). Normalised onto the circle. |
| `--speed` | yes |  | Speed in metres/second (1.4 ≈ walking, 25 ≈ driving) |
| `<position>` | yes |  | Starting position as a lat,lon token, e.g. 37.3349,-122.0090 |

### baguette location clear

Clear the simulated location, restoring live values

```
baguette location clear --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

## baguette motion

### baguette motion start

Arm motion and report an activity (relaunch the app afterwards)

```
baguette motion start --udid <udid> [--activity <activity>] [--speed <speed>] [--confidence <confidence>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--activity` |  | `walking` | stationary \| walking \| running \| cycling \| automotive |
| `--speed` |  |  | Speed in metres/second (default: the kind's usual pace) |
| `--confidence` |  | `high` | low \| medium \| high |

### baguette motion set

Change the reported activity without re-arming

```
baguette motion set --udid <udid> [--activity <activity>] [--speed <speed>] [--confidence <confidence>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--activity` |  | `walking` | stationary \| walking \| running \| cycling \| automotive |
| `--speed` |  |  | Speed in metres/second (default: the kind's usual pace) |
| `--confidence` |  | `high` | low \| medium \| high |

### baguette motion stop

Park the device as stationary and stop injecting motion

```
baguette motion stop --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

## baguette network

Condition the network — latency, bandwidth, loss, offline

### baguette network set

Condition the network (relaunch the app afterwards)

```
baguette network set --udid <udid> [--profile <profile>] [--latency <latency>] [--bandwidth <bandwidth>] [--loss <loss>] [--offline]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--profile` |  |  | Named preset |
| `--latency` |  |  | Round-trip latency in milliseconds |
| `--bandwidth` |  |  | Downlink bandwidth in kbps (omit to leave it unmetered) |
| `--loss` |  |  | Percentage of requests failed outright, 0-100 |
| `--offline` |  |  | Report no connection at all, as though the device were offline |

### baguette network clear

Stop conditioning, including for apps already running

```
baguette network clear --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

### baguette network status

Report the condition currently applied

```
baguette network status --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |

Print what a plugin contributes, without running it

Run a plugin command by its namespaced id

| `--url` |  | `http://127.0.0.1:8421` | Origin of a running `baguette serve`. |

| `--yes` |  |  | Accept the trust prompt for a new bakery without asking. |

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Re-install plugins from their bakery at its latest commit

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|

## baguette diag-digitizer-trackpad

Probe whether IndigoHIDMessageForTrackpadEventFromHIDEventRef accepts an IOHIDEvent digitizer-finger event

```
baguette diag-digitizer-trackpad --udid <udid> [--event-mask <event-mask>] [--x <x>] [--y <y>] [--pressure <pressure>] [--index <index>] [--identifier <identifier>] [--range] [--touch] [--dispatch] [--dump] [--compare-with-mouse] [--with-parent] [--patch-target] [--patch-edge <patch-edge>] [--swipe-end-y <swipe-end-y>] [--swipe-steps <swipe-steps>] [--swipe-step-ms <swipe-step-ms>] [--swipe-dwell-ms <swipe-dwell-ms>] [--cycle] [--hold-ms <hold-ms>]
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
| `--event-mask` |  | `0x04` | IOHIDDigitizerEventMask (hex). Default = 0x04 (Position). Touch-down = 0x07. |
| `--x` |  | `0.5` | Touch X (normalized 0..1) |
| `--y` |  | `0.5` | Touch Y (normalized 0..1) |
| `--pressure` |  | `0.0` | Tip pressure (0..1) |
| `--index` |  | `0` | Finger index |
| `--identifier` |  | `0` | Touch identifier |
| `--range` |  |  | Set the in-range bit on the digitizer event |
| `--touch` |  |  | Set the touching-surface bit on the digitizer event |
| `--dispatch` |  |  | After the wrapper accepts, send the message via SimDeviceLegacyHIDClient (may crash the sim if event shape is wrong) |
| `--dump` |  |  | Print the wrapper output as hex bytes so we can inspect message structure |
| `--compare-with-mouse` |  |  | Also build a mouse-event message at the same coords and dump bytes for comparison |
| `--with-parent` |  |  | Build a digitizer-parent event with the finger appended as a child (mirrors real iOS touch shape) |
| `--patch-target` |  |  | Overwrite the target slots at 0x6c + 0x10c with 0x32 (IndigoHIDTouchTarget) before dispatch |
| `--patch-edge` |  | `none` | Patch the edge slot. One of: none\|left\|top\|bottom\|right |
| `--swipe-end-y` |  |  | Run a swipe from y to this normalised end-y (sends down + 10 moves + up in one invocation) |
| `--swipe-steps` |  | `10` | Number of interpolated move events for the swipe (default 10) |
| `--swipe-step-ms` |  | `16` | Delay (ms) between move events (default 16 ≈ 60fps) |
| `--swipe-dwell-ms` |  | `0` | After reaching the end y, hold the finger there for this long (resending move events) before lifting. iOS uses dwell to discriminate Home vs App Switcher. |
| `--cycle` |  |  | Dispatch a paired touch-down + touch-up sequence (safer than a single event) |
| `--hold-ms` |  | `50` | Hold time between cycle down and up (ms) |

## baguette heal

Reclaim the input surface after Xcode 27's Device Hub attaches (restarts SpringBoard)

```
baguette heal --udid <udid>
```

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--udid` | yes |  | Simulator UDID |
